reuse.why: Extends the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend with holidays and adds a shared exported isHoliday, but the 'daily schedules skip off-days' rule is not given a shared definition and each consumer re-derives it.

duplication.why: The weekend-or-holiday test exists three times (isOff inside getDateWithSkippedWeekend, notWeekend in getNextDate, isOffDay in server/schedules/app.ts) and the 'skipWeekend && daily' decision is recomputed in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template.

placement.why: Holiday matching and the move rule correctly live in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-skip behaviour is implemented separately in the server app handlers and the budget template instead of in the shared schedule layer.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps (daily skip, range handler, holidays, MM-DD), with release notes and tests; rule-utils is extended to carry holidays and an isDaily flag.

maintainability.why: Four call sites each branch between skipping and moving with their own look-ahead heuristics (take 7+holidays, margin 3+holidays, unbounded loop), so a future change to the off-day rule has to be repeated and kept consistent by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange (server/schedules/app.ts) and createScheduleList (server/budget/schedule-template.ts) branch around getDateWithSkippedWeekend for daily schedules with their own off-day filtering.

disguised_duplication.where: The off-day predicate is reshaped as isOff (shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend), notWeekend (getNextDate) and isOffDay (app.ts), and the daily-skip condition is re-expressed as isDaily, isDailySkipped and config.frequency === 'daily' at different sites.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter (real variation); the daily-skip case is handled outside it at getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template createScheduleList, plus inline in getNextDate.
